request.state: SUNNY first scholarly census on sacred glyph-sound identification. Scope Paleo-Hebrew, Aramaic and English with Greek and Latin comparative controls. Need distinguish component transfer and counterexamples; preserve dated witnesses and exposure. No heterodox evidence or blind test now.

case.instructions: Choose the most tractable independently discriminating first inquiry.

criteria.aleph: Trace aleph and A by differentiating inherited graphic identity from inferred phonetic function and actual acoustics.
criteria.all: Attempt complete independent histories of all letters simultaneously.
criteria.numbers: Test whether numerical equivalence alone recovers historical pronunciation.

| Q07 | What are the competing explanations? |

| Q11 | What earlier historical traditions have scholars already connected to it? |
